meta.name: render-search-grid
meta.description: Render a 'search-grid' (Pinterest search-moodboard) video from a config — a real-DOM page with four continuous beats (masonry search grid + typing hook with counter-drift columns → 3 cards slide in from the right and stack → the top card box-grows to fullscreen then swipe-left ×2 through captioned feature shots → warm end card), frame-stepped via Chromium and encoded with FFmpeg — deterministic assembly, FREE (real brand photos + logo; the optional music bed comes from create-music-elevenlabs), so type/logo/photos stay pixel-crisp. Use for the search-grid format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将配置渲染为搜索灵感板视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从图片和配置自动生成 Pinterest 风格视频
copy.tagline_en: Render a search-moodboard video from a config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to auto-generate Pinterest-style videos from images and config

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据配置生成一段约 18 秒的 Pinterest 风格搜索网格视频，包含打字搜索、卡片滑动、全屏展示和结尾卡片，所有画面使用真实品牌图片和 Logo，文字清晰。
howto.when: 当你提供品牌图片、Logo 和文案等素材，并给出视频配置时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个搜索网格视频，配置用 example.json。
say.note: Claude 会读取配置并生成视频。

say.text: 用这些品牌图片和文案做一个 Pinterest 风格视频。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供具体素材。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate an ~18s Pinterest-style search-grid video from a config, featuring typing search, card sliding, fullscreen display, and end card, using real brand photos and logo with crisp text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide brand assets (images, logo, copy) and a video config.

say_en.text: Generate a search-grid video using the config example.json.
say_en.note: Claude will read the config and produce the video.

say_en.text: Make a Pinterest-style video with these brand images and copy.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for specific assets.
